title: CloudlessOS for NVIDIA DGX Spark
summary: A native ARM64 CloudlessOS appliance layer for the DGX Spark and its Grace Blackwell unified-memory platform.
changes: Detect DGX Spark and report GB10 unified memory accurately across hardware, model compatibility, and the interface.
Launch GPU containers through the Spark's NVIDIA CDI device and select validated ARM64 CUDA images automatically.
Install CloudlessOS reversibly over DGX OS while preserving NVIDIA's kernel, firmware, drivers, CUDA, recovery path, and Secure Boot chain.
Publish and update signed ARM64 Cloudless packages alongside AMD64 without allowing Cloudless to replace the DGX OS compute stack.
Add first-boot validation, safe desktop switching, recovery metadata, and privacy-conscious diagnostics for physical Spark systems.
